description: Defines C++ wrapper structs and functions for media stream info, samples, and utilities related to audio and video processing within the starboard media namespace.

classes.name: AudioStreamInfo
classes.description: C++ wrapper for SbMediaAudioStreamInfo, owning memory of its members.

classes.name: AudioSampleInfo
classes.description: C++ wrapper for SbMediaAudioSampleInfo, owning memory of its members.

classes.name: VideoStreamInfo
classes.description: C++ wrapper for SbMediaVideoStreamInfo, owning memory of its members.

classes.name: VideoSampleInfo
classes.description: C++ wrapper for SbMediaVideoSampleInfo, owning memory of its members.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison for media info structs.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison for media info structs.

methods.name: ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts wrapper structs to their corresponding SbMedia structs.
